meta.title: BIZBOT | بِزبط — Smart POS & operations system for restaurants and businesses
meta.description: BIZBOT (بِزبط) is one integrated system to run your restaurant or business: POS, Kitchen Display (KDS), self-service kiosks and a reporting dashboard — multi-device, trilingual, and it keeps selling even when the internet drops.

hero.title: A smart POS and operations system for your restaurant and business
hero.subtitle: POS, kitchen display, self-service kiosks and reports — one system that runs on every device you own, in three languages, and keeps orders, branches and staff in sync from the first tap to the final report.
hero.deviceAlt: The BIZBOT point-of-sale screen showing the menu grid and the order cart
hero.kdsAlt: The BIZBOT kitchen display showing tickets by status

products.title: Four modules. One system.
products.subtitle: From the cashier to the kitchen to the customer to the reports — every module is built to work with the others in real time.

items.title: Point of Sale (POS)
items.desc: A fast, simple interface for orders and sales on the floor: tables, takeaway, discounts, payment and instant printing.
items.alt: The point-of-sale screen inside a counter terminal next to a thermal receipt printer

items.title: Kitchen Display (KDS)
items.desc: Clear, instant organisation of kitchen orders: new, in progress, ready — with prep totals on every ticket.
items.alt: The kitchen display inside a dark kitchen screen

items.title: Self-service kiosks
items.desc: A modern, fast self-ordering experience for your customers: pick a table, browse the menu and send the order straight to the counter and kitchen.
items.alt: An upright self-service kiosk showing the welcome screen

items.title: Reports & operations
items.desc: Track sales, orders, staff and operations from one place: overview, menu, devices, tables and the activity log.
items.alt: The reports dashboard inside a tablet

features.title: Features that make the difference
features.subtitle: Built to help you run your business more efficiently and grow faster — without the complexity.

items.title: Order management
items.desc: Tables, takeaway and delivery from one screen, with the live status of every order.

items.title: Reports & analytics
items.desc: Today's sales, best-selling items and payments — clear numbers that support decisions.

items.title: Inventory management
items.desc: Track items, ingredients and availability per branch.

items.title: Staff management
items.desc: A personal account per employee with a PIN, role-based permissions and a full activity log.

items.title: Multilingual
items.desc: Arabic, English and Hebrew end to end — interfaces and receipts that respect text direction.

items.title: Fits many business types
items.desc: Restaurants, cafés, sweets, fast food, cloud kitchens… the same system.

items.title: Easy to use
items.desc: A simple interface a new employee learns in minutes — no long training.

items.title: Multi-device
items.desc: Runs on counter terminals, tablets, kitchen screens, kiosks and the browser.

items.title: Smart kitchen flow
items.desc: Tickets reach the kitchen the moment they are sent, with prep totals — fewer mistakes, more speed.

items.title: Fast setup
items.desc: Pair devices with a short code and start selling from your menu the same day.

items.title: Resilient operation
items.desc: The counter keeps selling if the internet drops and syncs automatically when it returns.

items.title: Performance tracking
items.desc: Branch readiness, devices and open orders at a glance from the dashboard.

statement.brandLine: More than a POS — a partner in your success.

business.title: Built for many kinds of businesses
business.subtitle: BIZBOT isn't only for restaurants — any business that needs a point of sale and organised operations fits right in.

items.title: Restaurants
items.desc: Tables, floor maps and a synced kitchen.

items.title: Cafés
items.desc: Quick orders at the counter or the kiosk.

items.title: Sweets & desserts
items.desc: Sell by piece or weight, plus pre-orders.

items.title: Fast food
items.desc: Speed at the queue and a clear kitchen screen.

items.title: Cloud kitchens
items.desc: Multi-channel orders on one screen.

items.title: And more
items.desc: Small shops, food trucks and any point of sale.

showcase.title: Real screens from inside BIZBOT
showcase.subtitle: Actual captures of the system as the cashier, the kitchen, the customer and the manager see it.

tabs.label: Point of Sale
tabs.title: A fast counter that never holds up the line
points: Categorised menu with instant search and item photos
Tables and a floor map, takeaway, and one-tap table assignment
Payment, discounts, and instant receipt and kitchen-ticket printing

tabs.label: Kitchen Display
tabs.title: The kitchen sees everything clearly
points: Columns by status: new, in progress, ready, done
Prep totals on every ticket to cut mistakes
A timer per order and ticket printing when needed

tabs.label: Kiosk
tabs.title: Your customer orders alone — fast and comfortable
points: A welcome screen in your brand and the customer's language
Pick a table or takeaway, then browse the menu with photos
Instant confirmation with an order number and a clear summary

tabs.label: Reports & operations
tabs.title: Decisions built on real numbers
points: An overview of sales, orders and payments for any period
Best-selling items and the latest orders in real time
Menu, staff and device management from the same place

why.title: Built for the busiest day of the week
why.subtitle: Clear engineering decisions that make the system dependable in daily operation — not just in a demo.

items.title: Works offline
items.desc: The counter keeps taking orders and payments during an outage and syncs everything automatically when the network is back.

items.title: Layered security
items.desc: A personal identity for every employee, paired and authorised devices, and role-based permissions — no shared passwords.

items.title: Multi-branch from day one
items.desc: One venue or a chain — the same system, with reports per branch or across all of them.

items.title: Thermal printing, ready
items.desc: Receipts and kitchen tickets on the usual thermal printers, in Arabic, Hebrew and English.

items.title: A complete activity log
items.desc: Every sensitive action is recorded: who, when and from which device — full transparency for the owner.

items.title: Continuous development, close support
items.desc: Regular updates across all modules, and support that understands how restaurants and shops really work.

pricing.title: Clear pricing that fits the size of your business
pricing.subtitle: Priced by the number of devices and branches — no hidden fees. Tell us about your business and we'll send a tailored quote.
includes: POS, kitchen display and the dashboard
